items.title: NOV Q2 Earnings Surpass Estimates, Revenues Decrease Y/Y
items.summary: NOV beats Q2 earnings and revenue estimates despite lower sales, as Energy Equipment strength, shareholder returns and upbeat Q3 guidance support momentum.

items.title: Expand Energy Q2 Earnings Beat Estimates on Strong Production
items.summary: EXE beats Q2 earnings estimates as higher production and reduced operating costs offset weaker revenues and lower natural gas prices.

items.title: Capital Market Earnings Crash Out
items.summary: Shares of capital market company MSCI and credit rating agency Equifax both posted double-digit declines in response to lackluster earnings.

items.title: Beetaloo Energy Signs Halliburton MOU for Gas-Powered Data Center Development
items.summary: Beetaloo Energy has signed a memorandum of understanding with Halliburton to support a proposed gas-powered AI data center development in Australia's Northern Territory.

items.title: SLB Growth Outlook Hinges on Offshore, Digital and Production Gains
items.summary: SLB's offshore scale, digital growth and ChampionX production strengthen its long-term growth outlook for 2027, but Middle East risks and net debt cloud the near term.

items.title: Halliburton Bags Spate of Middle East Contracts in July
items.summary: Halliburton announced a spate of contract awards in the Middle East this month.

items.title: Is LBRT Stock Attractive After Its Sharp Pullback and Earnings Beat?
items.summary: Liberty Energy beats Q2 estimates and trades below its subindustry on forward sales, but margin pressure and heavy growth spending keep the outlook mixed.

items.title: Baker Hughes Rises as Energy Infrastructure Demand Outweighs Middle East Disruptions
items.summary: Baker Hughes stock is one of the top-performing stocks in the S&P 500 on Monday as second-quarter earnings show the oilfield services company is successfully navigating the situation in the Middle East.
